newsitem.title: USA: New Castle County, Del., approves $143 mln budget.
newsitem.headline: New Castle County, Del., approves $143 mln budget.

text.p: The New Castle County Council has approved a $143 million budget, reflecting a $2.6 million dollar cut in spending.
Councilman Bob Woods, chairman of the finance committee, said the cuts come from the elimination of 44 vacant jobs and the consolidation of ten county departments into five.
Along with holding the line on taxes, the council kept sewer charges at the same rate for the third consecutive year.
